headline: iFixit's look inside the iPhone Duo may explain those broken screens and hinges
summary: iFixit's teardown of the iPhone Duo reveals internal design details. Findings suggest how Apple might hide the foldable screen's crease. The device received a 5/10 repairability score, a high for Apple's foldables.

headline: Scott Walker's The Drift will get under your skin
summary: Scott Walker's 2006 album 'The Drift' is reviewed as genuinely terrifying. The music is described as deeply upsetting and unsettling. It's recommended for those seeking truly chilling sounds for 'Spooky Season'.

headline: A YouTuber dissected an iPhone Duo and thinks he found the cause of crackgate
summary: Reports of iPhone Duo hinge and screen failures are widespread on social media. Users claim their foldable phones crack rapidly, some within hours of purchase. A YouTuber's dissection aims to pinpoint the cause of these 'crackgate' issues.

headline: Zen Browser is the Arc replacement I was looking for
summary: Many users lament the loss of the innovative Arc browser. Atlassian acquired Arc, shifting focus to its AI-centric browser, Dia. Zen Browser is presented as a compelling new alternative for former Arc enthusiasts.

headline: X-Men Actor Christopher Abbott Insists His Professor X Is Not in Doomsday or Secret Wars
summary: X-Men actor Christopher Abbott clarifies his Professor X role. He confirms he will not appear in Avengers: Doomsday or Secret Wars. Abbott needs to conclude his current X-Men commitments before considering future cameos.

headline: Clayface Looks Like a Win for the DCU After Earning $43 Million in Box Office Opening Weekend
summary: The new DCU film 'Clayface' secured the top spot at the box office. It achieved an estimated global haul of $43 million in its opening weekend. This strong performance signals a significant success for the DC Universe.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Xenoblade Chronicles 2, Persona 3 Reload, Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, and More
summary: Discover the best gaming deals available on October 25, 2026. Featured titles include discounts on Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and Persona 3 Reload. Find offers on Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake and other popular games.

headline: Mass Effect Leaks Reveal Canceled BioWare Game's Story Would Have Accounted for 'All' Choices From Previous Games
summary: New leaks expose details of a canceled BioWare Mass Effect game. The unreleased story aimed to integrate 'all' player choices from the Commander Shepard trilogy. EA's studio shutdown ultimately prevented this ambitious project from release.

headline: Two men killed by falling trees as Storm Boelo leaves 160,000 properties without power
summary: Storm Boelo caused the deaths of two men due to falling trees. The severe weather left 160,000 properties across the UK without power. An amber wind warning, previously in effect, has now expired.

headline: Serbia's veteran ruler Vučić concedes election to student-led protest movement
summary: Serbia's long-serving populist leader, Vučić, conceded election defeat. His party lost the vote to a student-led protest movement. The election was seen as a crucial referendum on the country's future direction.

headline: Funding set to double for plan to get rough sleepers off streets by Christmas
summary: Funding will double for a critical plan to house rough sleepers. The initiative aims to get individuals off the streets by Christmas. Ending rough sleeping was a key pledge made by Downing Street in July.

headline: Letter making claims about Meghan's father written by his first wife, BBC understands
summary: A letter containing 'disturbing allegations' about Meghan's father has emerged. The BBC understands his first wife, Roslyn Loveless, wrote the letter. Meghan was reportedly informed of these allegations in 2018.
